title: Common affine models for two perfect objects
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E,F\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], and $x\in X$. There is an affine open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ and strictly perfect complexes $A^\bullet,B^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O_U$-modules with isomorphisms $E|_U\cong Q(A^\bullet)$ and $F|_U\cong Q(B^\bullet)$.

proof.text: Choose the two local witnesses in [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Their intersection contains $x$. The affine-open basis of a scheme [def-pc-scheme] supplies an affine neighbourhood $W$ contained in that intersection; no separatedness assumption is needed.

For each inclusion $W\subset U$, use the exact restriction functor $\operatorname{overMap}$ of [lem-sc-derived-hom-mayer-vietoris]. It preserves zero objects. Its unit-sheaf isomorphism and preservation of coproducts identify the image of each finite free module with the finite free module of the same rank. Map the retract pair and conjugate by this isomorphism; its composite stays the identity. Thus the termwise restriction remains strictly perfect.

The natural comparison $\operatorname{overFunctor}(U)\circ\operatorname{overMap}(W\subset U)\cong\operatorname{overFunctor}(W)$ induces a comparison on the localized categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Compose its inverse with the composition isomorphism of exact derived functors, the image of the original representing isomorphism, and the comparison with termwise restriction followed by $Q$. Do this for both witnesses to give the common affine models.

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_common_affine_models (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E F : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : IsPerfect X E) (hF : IsPerfect X F) (x : X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∃ A B : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ,
        IsStrictlyPerfect X U A ∧ IsStrictlyPerfect X U B ∧
        Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj A) ∧
        Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj F ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj B)
